about: Files, pictures and audio recordings in direct messages (the lead's contract, 2026-11-21; NIP-17 kind 15). Each file = one kind 15 rumor, sealed and gift-wrapped like a kind 14 to every participant and to yourself (in a sealed conversation through the device seal, as for 14). Before upload the device encrypts the file with AES-256-GCM, a fresh random 32-byte key and 12-byte nonce per file, no associated data, the 16-byte tag appended to the ciphertext; it uploads the CIPHERTEXT to the belfry's Blossom (Content-Type application/octet-stream; same limits as channels). Rumor content = the blob URL. Tags in this order: p per other participant; ["file-type", mime]; ["encryption-algorithm", "aes-gcm"]; ["decryption-key", hex]; ["decryption-nonce", hex]; ["x", sha256 of the ciphertext]; ["ox", sha256 of the plain file]; ["size", bytes of the plain file]; then optional ["name", file name] (sent for files; inside the sealed rumor, so the server never sees it; shown as in the names section: the last path segment, no control characters or direction marks, trimmed, at most 200 UTF-16 units, else File / Picture / Audio recording), ["dim", "WxH"], ["blurhash", ...], ["thumb", url] + ["thumb-nonce", hex] (the thumbnail encrypted with the file's key and its own nonce), ["duration", seconds] (audio: m4a/AAC as in channels), ["group", 16 hex]. Several pictures sent together: kind 15s in order sharing one group tag, created_at strictly increasing (the outbox rule max(last + 1, now)); a caption = a kind 14 right after with the same group tag. Readers show a group (same author, same group) as one bubble: files by created_at (ties: rumor id), the caption under them. Reactions on a file: dm-reactions.json with ["k", "15"]. Deleting: as for 14. Readers: download, check x, decrypt, check ox; any mismatch or a missing / malformed tag shows "This file can't be opened", never the bytes. Decrypted files are cached only in the app's private storage. Sending goes through the outbox like a direct message: the upload is a step of the item (in the send trace); a refused upload (4xx except 401 / 408 / 429) fails the item (outbox.json).

reaction.note: a reaction to the picture: as dm-reactions.json, k = 15

read.note: a changed byte: x does not match
x matches but the key is wrong: GCM's tag fails
decrypts, but ox is another file's
the thumbnail: the file's key, its own nonce

bubbles.note: rumors as they arrived (any order) → the bubbles in time order (a bubble's time = its first rumor's); same group from another author is another bubble
